name: How long does a whole home remodel usually take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole home remodel usually take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines for a full-scope remodel depend directly on the home's square footage, structural changes, and the delivery schedules of finish materials. A typical multi-room or entire-house interior project can take anywhere from three to seven months. The process begins with structural framing, sub-trade rough-ins for electrical and plumbing, and municipal inspections. Once hidden systems pass inspection, work proceeds through drywall installation, tile and marble setting, trim carpentry, and final paint. Unforeseen structural issues behind older walls or delays in custom cabinetry orders can extend this schedule, making early material selections crucial for staying on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: A whole-home remodel typically takes between three to seven months, depending on square footage, structural modifications, and material delivery lead times.
